link.title: MCP servers
link.description: The Model Context Protocol lets an AI coding agent look things up and run tools while it works, instead of guessing from memory. Bitbybit runs two servers: the free Bitbybit CAD MCP, which documents the exact API of the version you use, and the Bitbybit CAD Cloud MCP, which runs geometry on CAD Cloud for an API key. These pages connect them to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, claude.ai, ChatGPT and the Claude API, and describe what each tool answers. Context7 is covered as a third-party alternative.
